name: Colt Express Big Box

categories.label: Purses total ($)
categories.hint: Reveal and add the face values of your purses ($250-$500 each)

categories.label: Gunslinger prize
categories.hint: $1000 to each player who fired the most bullets (fewest own Bullet cards left); ties each get it

tiebreakers.description: Tied player who received the fewest Bullet cards wins

endCondition.description: Game ends after the fifth Round.

notes: family: set-collection-money. Values are in dollars. 2-player variant: each player has two bandits; sum the loot of both bandits, and the Gunslinger total excludes bullets one of your bandits shot at the other. Big Box expansion modules (Horses & Stagecoach, Marshal & Prisoners) and any extra loot types or scoring changes were NOT verified. Rulebook read via a third-party transcription, not the publisher PDF.

sources.title: Colt Express rulebook transcription (RulesPal)
sources.section: Object of the Game; End of the Game; 2 Bandits Per Player
